reasoning_content: The log ended with scaffolding and PHP CodeSniffer configuration, but I haven't seen the "Generating autoload files" or completion messages yet. The process list from earlier didn't show any running composer (only my own grep). Let me check whether the background job is still running, and also check the end of the log. It seems like it might have completed. Let me look for the final message like "Generating autoload files" or "Nothing to modify".

action.command: grep -n "Generating autoload\|Nothing to modify\|Error\|error\|Warning" /tmp/composer_install.log | tail -10; echo "==="; ps aux | grep -E "[d]ev composer|[c]omposer i" | head; echo "==="; ls /workspace/web 2>/dev/null | head; echo "==="; ls /workspace/vendor 2>/dev/null | head -5
